alis.role: primary direct-MYSTIC full-spectrum source for photopic, scotopic, and Johnson-V channel derivation
alis.channelDerivation: use frozen derive_channels() on exact mc.rad.spc 8001-node grid
alis.replicateHandling: derive each replicate independently, then report arithmetic mean, sample standard deviation, coefficient of variation, and pairwise relative difference for each channel

referenceVroom.forbiddenUse: do not derive or substitute full photopic/scotopic/Johnson-V channels from the sparse VROOM grid
referenceVroom.comparison: compare VROOM radiance at the 15 common diagnostic nodes against ALIS full-spectrum radiance at the identical wavelengths; report signed and absolute relative differences

levelBComparison.eventGeometrySource: binding live date-transformed Level-B rows from run 33025015603 only
levelBComparison.stabilitySamples: Level-B +30 s and +60 s samples are frozen only to confirm the original 60 s Three-Star event semantics; they are not additional direct-MYSTIC geometries in this batch
levelBComparison.levelBSpectralChannelTreatment: Level-B spectral runtime is unavailable; direct MYSTIC spectrum must not be described as validation of a Level-B full-spectrum runtime that does not exist

skyOnlyVisibilitySubstitution.purpose: isolate sky-surrogate effect on the current equilibrium human-threshold margin
skyOnlyVisibilitySubstitution.stellarSignalTreatment: hold each star's frozen Level-B apparentVMagAtEye fixed; do not replace stellar extinction in this calculation
skyOnlyVisibilitySubstitution.backgroundTreatment: replace only backgroundLuminanceCdM2 with the mean direct-MYSTIC ALIS photopic luminance for that geometry
skyOnlyVisibilitySubstitution.calculation: use exact human-threshold module evaluatePointSourceVisibility semantics from applicationMainSha
outputs: delta limiting magnitude versus frozen Level-B event
delta visibility margin versus frozen Level-B event

separateDiagnostics.matchedFamilyStellarExtinction: report separately from sky-surrogate substitution; do not fold into direct-sky-only margin
separateDiagnostics.humanThresholdTopology: F remains 3.14 configured baseline; already-completed 2.4 and 2.0 results are sensitivity only and must not alter this direct-MYSTIC comparison
separateDiagnostics.transientAdaptation: report separately as experimental; the corrected Tammuz transient event must not be used to tune or reinterpret the equilibrium direct-MYSTIC sky comparison
